title: Three Paths Choice
next_chapter_hook: When the truth of the first path was revealed, Chen Ji finally understood that the so-called freedom required the very things he was most unwilling to lose...

text.content: When chaos first began to open, the Heavenly Secret Eye opened its first gaze from the depths of the Void. It was neither benevolent nor malevolent, merely coldly observing the birth and death cycles of all things in the world.

dialogue.content: "The Tianji Record... it's finally complete." That voice was ancient and distant, as if piercing through from the primordial chaos, "You thought this was fortune? No, this is merely another piece I have placed upon the chessboard of this world."

text.content: Chen Ji felt the spiritual pressure around him suddenly surge, as if invisible giant hands were crushing him. However, in the next instant, a beam of ink-colored light shot out from the Tianji Record, forcibly repelling that spiritual pressure.

dialogue.content: The remnant soul slowly emerged from the pages of the book. Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of mockery: "Heavenly Secret Eye, why bother quarreling with a junior? Look carefully—this chess game is no longer something you alone can control."

text.content: At this moment, all the fragments of the Tianji Record completely merged. A brilliant golden light shot upward, slowly unfolding into three light gates in the Void. The three paths of destiny lay spread out before Chen Ji.
Above the first light gate, two ancient seal characters appeared: Freedom. Within the light gate was nothing but emptiness, no images at all, only endless silence and solitude.

Above the second light gate was written: Replace. Within the light gate, Chen Ji saw a figure seated above the Nine Heavens, gazing down at all living beings. The face of that figure... was exactly the same as his own.

The third light gate was inscribed with: Common End. Within it, flames burned the heavens, the Heavenly Secret Eye and the Tianji Record shattered simultaneously, and the figure standing in the center of the sea of fire also turned to nothingness.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice grew solemn: "Look carefully, Three Paths Choice. The first path severs all bonds and cuts through fate's entanglement, granting true freedom—the cost is everyone and everything you care about."

"The second path, replace the Heavenly Secret Eye. You will become the new Chess Player, looking down upon all beings—however, your consciousness will be assimilated by the heavens, no longer Chen Ji, only a tool."
"The third path, perish together. Burn away the Heavenly Secret Eye, destroy the Tianji Record, and destroy yourself—this is the most thorough path, and also the one with the heaviest price."

text.content: Chen Ji stared at the first light gate, his voice tight: "The path of freedom... what exactly needs to be done?" He needed to know every detail, every price. This was his instinct for scheming across the world—never make decisions without complete information.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, his remnant soul's form slightly trembling: "The path of freedom requires the following steps to be completed within thirty days—" He raised his hand, and three talismans appeared in the air.

text.content: The first talisman: Sever Attachments. Chen Ji must personally destroy all traces he left in this world—his created forces, his woven connections, every piece he had secretly positioned.
The second talisman: Erase Memories. He must forget the faces and names of all important people—Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, Mo Xiansheng, even his long-sought sister Chen Nian.

The third talisman: Sever Heavenly Fate. He must completely zero out his Heavenly Fate Value—this means abandoning all abilities granted by the Tianji Record, and also means losing the final capital to contend against the heavens.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." The Heavenly Secret Eye's voice rang out again, carrying a trace of mockery, "If you choose this path, what will happen to that woman Su Qingyao? She gave everything for you. Can you bear to let her face the coming storm alone?"

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his fists, his knuckles turning white. He closed his eyes, as if seeing Su Qingyao's desperate expression upon learning the truth, then Ye Qing's image being hunted by the Holy Sect, and his sister Chen Nian... the one he had sworn to find.
Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly softened slightly: "The freedom of the first path... is true freedom, yet also the most cruel freedom. You will no longer be anyone, just an empty shell."

choice.prompt: Each of the three paths had its pros and cons, and Chen Ji had to weigh the ultimate proposition of life, death, and freedom within the limited time. At this moment, he needed to make the first judgment:

choices.text: Inquire for more details about the path of freedom
choices.description: The cost of the path of freedom is the clearest—sever bonds, forget everything, lose Heavenly Fate. But this is also the cleanest path.
choices.visible_reward: Thoroughly break free from the control of the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: Will forget Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, Chen Nian, and all others

text.content: Chen Ji said in a deep voice: 'If I choose the path of freedom, then what price is needed for the second path of replacement?' He must compare all options to make the final judgment.

choices.text: Inquire about the price of the replacement path
choices.description: Replacing the Eye of Heavenly Dao means becoming a new chess player, but Mo Xiansheng said the consciousness will be assimilated—how deep does this assimilation go?
choices.visible_cost: Lose self-consciousness, be assimilated by Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Become the new master of Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: After consciousness is assimilated, one is no longer Chen Ji

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze turned to the second light gate: 'Replacing the Eye of Heavenly Dao... what specific steps are needed?' His tone was calm, but cold light flickered in the depths of his eyes.

choices.text: Inquire about the possibility of the mutual destruction path
choices.description: Mutual destruction seems heroic, but can they only be destroyed together? Is there a third path? Chen Ji never makes decisions without a way out.
choices.visible_reward: Completely destroy the Eye of Heavenly Dao

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed lightly: 'Mutual destruction... not necessarily. Mo Xiansheng, is the inheritance distribution plan left by the First Observer related to these three paths?'

dialogue.content: A flash of appreciation appeared in Mo Xiansheng's eyes: 'You are indeed perceptive. The First Observer's inheritance is not just the Tianji Record fragment—there are also three relics, each corresponding to one of the three paths.'

text.content: Three streams of light flew out from Mo Xiansheng's body, suspended in the void. The first was a crystal-clear gem shaped like a teardrop, emanating a faint aura of farewell.

dialogue.content: 'This is the River of Forgetfulness Tear. Dripping it on the brow center can erase the memory of the designated person—but can only be used once per day, and requires the user to sacrifice ten years of their lifespan.'

text.content: The second was a crown as black as ink, covered with dense runes, each rune slightly writhing, as if countless lives were wailing within.

dialogue.content: 'This is the Puppet Crown. Wearing it allows you to temporarily replace part of the Eye of Heavenly Dao's authority—but each use erodes your self-consciousness a bit more. Wear it three times, and you will completely disappear.'

text.content: The third was a sword entirely crimson red, with nine seals on its blade, and chaos fire burning eternally along its edge—the Dao-Burning Sword.

dialogue.content: 'The Dao-Burning Sword... was the blade the First Observer used to mutually destroy with the Eye of Heavenly Dao. From the day the sword was forged, he knew this was a dead end—yet he still chose to leave this sword.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a touch of sorrow.

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly spoke: 'Was the First Observer... walking this path voluntarily?' This question seemed unrelated, yet it struck at the core.

dialogue.content: 'Clever.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice suddenly turned icy cold, 'The First Observer did indeed choose voluntarily—because he discovered he had long become my puppet. The so-called 'choice' was merely an illusion I let him see.'

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul shuddered violently, clearly struck at a painful point. He fell silent for a long while before murmuring: 'So... until the very end, he didn't know he was a chess piece.'

dialogue.content: "And you, Chen Ji—do you think you've been arranging the world, leaving nothing to chance? No, all your struggles are before my eyes. Every path you see, I am the one who shows it to you."

text.content: "Chen Ji suddenly laughed. That laughter echoed through the void, carrying an inexplicable quality. He raised his head, staring directly at that虚无的目光."
"'Is that so?' Chen Ji's tone was calm, yet carried a terrifying confidence, 'Then have you ever considered... that I knew you were watching me long ago?'"
"In the void, the atmosphere suddenly froze. The Heavenly Dao's Eye fell silent for a moment, then emitted a low, cold laugh: 'Interesting... then let me see, what is your trump card after all?'"

dialogue.content: "Mr. Mo suddenly burst into laughter, his remnant soul's form radiating unprecedented brilliance: 'Excellent! Excellent, Chen Ji! Truly worthy of... the one he chose!' His voice carried excitement and anticipation."

text.content: "Just then, the three artifacts suddenly emitted simultaneous hums. Forget River's Tear radiated a desolate blue light, the Puppet King's Crown ignited with eerie purple flames, and the chaos flames on the Sword of Burning Dao surged several times stronger."

dialogue.content: "'The artifacts have recognized their master...' Mr. Mo's voice suddenly filled with excitement, 'This means... you truly qualify to choose the fourth path!'"

text.content: "Chen Ji raised an eyebrow: 'The fourth path? I thought there were only three.' His tone remained calm, but his mind was already racing."

dialogue.content: "'Impossible!' The Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice carried the first hint of disturbance, 'The artifacts cannot recognize a master simultaneously—unless... unless he truly accomplished that thing!'"
"Mr. Mo turned to Chen Ji, his eyes filled with complex emotions: 'You... have you brought Chen Nian before the Tianji Record?'"

text.content: "Chen Ji didn't answer, but his silence itself was the answer. Mr. Mo took a deep breath, his voice becoming grave: 'Heavenly Fate's Lock Key... she is the key to breaking the Three Paths cycle.'"
"The light from the three artifacts intertwined and merged in the void, ultimately forming a completely new gate of light. Above the gate, two ancient characters emerged—Against Fate."

choice.prompt: "The emergence of the fourth path 'Against Fate' shattered all assumptions. Chen Ji now needed to make a crucial judgment:"

choices.text: "Inquire about the details of Against Fate path"
choices.description: "The fourth path has never been recorded, the artifacts' simultaneous recognition proves this path is viable. But what is the cost of Against Fate? How great is the risk?"
choices.risk_hint: "No one has ever walked this path"

dialogue.content: "Mr. Mo took a deep breath: 'The path of Against Fate... requires your sister's cooperation. She is the Heavenly Fate's Lock Key, capable of interfering with the Tianji Record's foresight—and also interfering with the Heavenly Dao's Eye's observation.'"

choices.memory_label: 发现了第四条路，需要陈念配合

choices.description: "The Heavenly Dao's Eye said it controls everything Chen Ji can see—could this 'fourth path' be a new trap it set?"
choices.risk_hint: "Could be the Heavenly Dao's Eye's new deception"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji sneered: 'Heavenly Dao's Eye, you wouldn't be trying to lead me down a path more to your liking through this, would you?' His gaze was sharp as a blade."

choices.description: There are still thirty days, no need to rush to decide now. Gather more information first, understand all the details of each path before making a judgment.
choices.visible_reward: More information, a more complete judgment
choices.risk_hint: Limited time, may miss the opportunity

text.content: Chen Ji looked around: "Thirty days... enough for me to see more." He turned to Mo Xiansheng, "Before that, I need to know—how did the First Observer fail?"

dialogue.content: "Do you think stalling will help?" The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice carried disdain, "After thirty days, no matter what you choose, the chess game will end. The only difference is—who is the piece, and who is the player."

text.content: Chen Ji ignored the Eye of Heavenly Dao's provocation and looked at Mo Xiansheng: "The reason the First Observer failed—it's because he didn't know he was a piece. What about you? How much do you know?"

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a long while, his remnant soul's figure wavering slightly: "What I know... is only what I am allowed to know. I was created to guide you to this point. As for what comes after... I cannot see."

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly reached out and gripped the three relics simultaneously in his palm. The coldness of Forgetful River's Tears, the heaviness of the Puppet King's Crown, the burning heat of the Dao-Burning Sword—three entirely different sensations flooded into his perception at once.
The three relics trembled violently in his palm, seeming to want to break free yet not daring to. Three distinctly different powers converged within Chen Ji's body, forming a strange equilibrium.

dialogue.content: "You're insane!" The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice carried terror for the first time, "Bearing the power of three relics simultaneously, your body will—"

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing, only slowly closing his eyes. The three powers collided and merged within his body, like three giant pythons tearing at each other. His features contorted with pain, yet he made no sound.

Mo Xiansheng watched nervously, his remnant soul's hands tightly clenched together. The time of an incense stick felt like a century. Finally, Chen Ji opened his eyes—within those eyes, tears, the purple glow of the crown, and the crimson red of the Dao-Burning Sword flickered simultaneously.

Chen Ji opened his palm; the three relics had vanished, replaced by three markings appearing on his palm—Forgetful River's Tears, Puppet's Crown, and Dao-Burning Fire. The three marks in hand signified he now had the possibility to wield all three paths simultaneously.

dialogue.content: "The fourth path—Defying Destiny." Chen Ji's voice was calm and resolute, "Not choosing one among them, but merging all three paths into one. You didn't anticipate this, did you?" He looked toward the void, a cold smile tugging at his lips.

text.content: From the void came the Eye of Heavenly Dao's压抑的怒吼："这不可能！三途之力相互冲突，任何人都不可能同时承载——你到底做了什么！"
陈机看着自己掌心的三道纹路，忽然轻声笑了："你以为我看不出吗？所谓的三途抉择，不过是第一观测者留下的试炼。而真正的答案，从来都不在这三条路之中。"

dialogue.content: 他抬起头，目光仿佛穿透无尽虚空，直视那道超越一切的存在："天道之眼，你布下的棋局确实精妙。但你忘了一件事——我不是棋子。"

text.content: 墨先生看着眼前的少年，眼中满是震撼与欣慰。他喃喃自语："原来如此……第四条路，从一开始就在。只是需要找到它的人——"
就在此时，虚空深处忽然传来一声轻响。一道光芒从遥远的方向射来，落在陈机身上。那是……来自天青宗的方向。
陈机感应到那道光芒中蕴含的熟悉气息，瞳孔骤然收缩——那是苏青瑶的灵识印记。她的声音跨越千里传来："陈机，速回天青宗！凌渊……他动了！"
凌渊。那个被天机录跳过的上一代传承候选人，那个对陈机表面庇护实则暗藏祸心的老掌门——在三十日倒计时的第二十九天，终于露出了獠牙。
陈机收回手掌，目光平静地扫过三道光门："看来，有人不想让我安稳地完成选择。"他转身看向墨先生，"苏青瑶的情况如何？"

dialogue.content: 墨先生闭上眼，片刻后睁开："她暂时无恙，但凌渊已经封锁了天青宗所有出路。而且……"他的声音变得凝重，"凌渊手中，似乎也有天机录的残页。"

text.content: Chen Ji let out a cold laugh: "As expected of an old fox. He's been waiting for this moment all along, hasn't he?" He stood with hands behind his back, his black hair gently floating in the void. "But... does he really think this can trap me?"
Mo Xiansheng looked at the three new marks appearing on Chen Ji's palm and suddenly understood: "You're going to... activate all three marks simultaneously? If you do that, your Heavenly Fate will—"

dialogue.content: "Heavenly Fate?" Chen Ji gently shook his head, a hint of nonchalance curling at the corner of his lips. "From the day I obtained the Tianji Record, I never intended to live up to what the Eye of Heavenly Dao expected of me."

text.content: He raised his hand, and all three marks on his palm burst forth with dazzling radiance simultaneously. The sorrow of Forgetful River's Tears, the domineering authority of Puppet King's Crown, the resolve of Burnt Dao Sword—three distinctly different powers fused perfectly within him, forming an entirely new order.

"The path of defying destiny officially begins." Chen Ji's voice echoed through the void, carrying unshakeable resolve. "Ling Yuan wants to take advantage of the chaos? Fine—let him witness what it truly means to scheme for the world."

Mo Xiansheng gazed upon this young man, his heart filled with mixed emotions. He seemed to glimpse the figure of the First Observer in his youth—the same spirited ambition, the same meticulous planning. Yet Chen Ji... possessed something the First Observer lacked.

dialogue.content: "You're stronger than the First Observer." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a sense of emotion. "Because you understand better than him... what is truly worth protecting."

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer. He turned to gaze toward the direction of the Tianqing Sect, a hint of tenderness flickering in his eyes—the expression that only appeared when thinking of Su Qingyao. After a moment, he withdrew his gaze, his expression hardening once more.

"Let's go." Chen Ji stepped through the gate of void. "The thirty-day countdown... begins now. Since Ling Yuan wants to be the one to stick his head out first, let him become the first... sacrifice burned to ashes by the flames of defying destiny."

The moment Chen Ji stepped into the territory of the Tianqing Sect, he saw a familiar figure standing before the sect gate. Su Qingyao, dressed in blue robes, sword drawn, blocked before Ling Yuan. Her slender yet resolute back resembled an insurmountable barrier.
The withered face of Ling Yuan wore a facade of false compassion: "Qingyao, why must you make an enemy of this old man for a废物 disciple? If you step aside now, the past can be forgotten."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao let out a cold laugh, her sword tip pointing directly at Ling Yuan: "废物? Ling Sect Master certainly speaks with great confidence. Secretly colluding with the Demonic Path, murdering fellow disciples, coveting the Tianji Record—shall I enumerate each of these deeds?"

text.content: Ling Yuan's expression finally darkened, his disguise completely torn away: "You're seeking death!" He raised his hand, and a vast spiritual pressure descended upon Su Qingyao like a mountain. Yet just then, a voice rang out from within the void—

dialogue.content: "Ling Elder Sect Master, why such great anger?" Chen Ji slowly stepped out from the void, his signature nonchalant smile on his face. "While I was away, this is how you took care of my people?"

text.content: Su Qingyao turned her head, and the instant she saw Chen Ji, a complex emotion flickered in her eyes—concern, reproach, but more so, relief. She softly said: "You've finally arrived."
When Ling Yuan saw Chen Ji, he froze momentarily, then burst into laughter: "Hahaha... Chen Ji, you've arrived at the perfect time! This old man has waited整整 thirty years for this day!"

He slowly unfolded his palm, and a page emanating ancient aura floated forth—a fragment containing forbidden knowledge. The eyes of Ling Yuan burned with madness: "The Tianji Record chose you but forgot me—today, this old man shall rectify this mistake!"

Chen Ji stared at the fragment, his pupils slightly contracting. He had believed all fragments of the Tianji Record were already gathered, never expecting Ling Yuan to possess the final page. This was the only flaw in his grand design.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji sighed softly, a hint of regret in his tone: "It seems I still underestimated you, Ling Elder Sect Master. However—" His gaze fell upon Su Qingyao, a smile curling at his lips. "Since I've arrived, I won't allow anyone to lay a finger on her."

text.content: Ling Yuan sneered: "Just a废物 disciple like you?" He channeled the eighth page fragment, and a world-destroying force suddenly erupted. This was the power of Heavenly Dao contained within the Tianji Record fragment—he was actually bargaining with the Eye of Heavenly Dao!

A cold light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. He raised his right hand, and the three marks on his palm illuminated simultaneously. The blue glow of Forgetful River's Tears, the purple radiance of Puppet King's Crown, the crimson fire of Burnt Dao Sword intertwined, forming a dazzling tri-colored halo.

dialogue.content: "废物?" Chen Ji's voice was calm yet carried irresistible authority. "Ling Elder Sect Master, you plotted with tigers, yet did not realize the cage was prepared long ago." He lightly raised his hand. "Now, let me show you what true—heavenly secrets truly are."

text.content: The tri-colored halo abruptly expanded, completely enveloping the Heavenly Dao power Ling Yuan released. That world-destroying force thrashed wildly within the halo, yet like a cornered beast, it could not break free in the slightest.

Ling Yuan's expression drastically changed, his eyes filled with disbelief: "Impossible! How can you possess the power of three marks? That is the stuff of legends—" His voice abruptly stopped, for he saw the three marks on Chen Ji's palm.

dialogue.content: Just then, a voice from the depths of the void echoed from the Eye of Heavenly Dao, no longer arrogant but carrying an unusual solemnity: "Chen Ji... are you certain you wish to do this? The consequences of merging three marks, you should understand clearly."

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer. He merely increased his force slightly, and the three-colored halo abruptly contracted. Ling Yuan let out a bloodcurdling scream as the eighth page fragment slipped from his grasp, being drawn into Chen Ji's palm by the three-colored halo.

Ling Yuan, drenched in blood, collapsed to the ground, his eyes filled with fear: "You... what kind of monster are you..." He struggled to flee, only to discover that his cultivation had been completely sealed by the three-colored halo.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji walked up to Ling Yuan, gazing down at this once-arrogant old sect master. His voice was soft, yet it chilled Ling Yuan to the bone: "Old Sect Master Ling, you studied the Tianji Record your entire life, yet never understood one truth—"

text.content: "What truly terrifies is not the Heavenly Secrets—but the person who controls them." Chen Ji bent down, picking up the fragment. "You've lost. Lost because of your excessive greed."

Su Qingyao walked to Chen Ji's side, gazing at the former sect master with a complex expression: "What happens next?" Her voice had softened considerably. "He was always the sect master of Tianqing Sect..."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gently held Su Qingyao's hand: "Don't worry, I have my limits." He turned to look at Ling Yuan. "Old Sect Master Ling, the evidence of your collusion with the Demonic Path and your treasonous intentions—I have already had it compiled. Tomorrow at the sect's Council Hall, you'll explain it yourself."

text.content: Ling Yuan shuddered all over, a flash of despair flickering in his eyes. The Council Hall... that was the trial hall he had personally established to deal with erring disciples. Now, it was his turn to sit in the defendant's seat.

After handling Ling Yuan, Chen Ji lowered his head to look at the eighth page fragment in his hand. The fragment connected with the Tianji Record's main body, emanating a soft glow. He closed his eyes, and the complete information of the Tianji Record surged into his mind once more.

The truth of the three paths was completely unveiled before his eyes—the end of the path of freedom was eternal solitude in emptiness; the end of the path of replacement was becoming a puppet of the Heavenly Eye; the end of the path of shared destruction was total annihilation.

And the path he had chosen—reversing fate—the true cost was also revealed. The three-pattern power was not without price; every use consumed his Heavenly Fate. And at the end of the path of reversing fate...
"I need to trade my life for Chen Nian's freedom." Chen Ji murmured softly, his eyes showing not the slightest hesitation. "Worth it."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao suddenly spoke up: "Chen Ji, what are you saying?" She seemed to sense something. "What do you mean 'worth it'? What are you hiding from me?"

text.content: Chen Ji turned to look at Su Qingyao, his gaze tender yet carrying a trace of apology. He gently stroked her hair: "Nothing, I was just thinking... after we find Chen Nian, where should our family go to live?"

A flash of suspicion crossed Su Qingyao's eyes, but she did not press further. She knew Chen Ji had many secrets, and she knew everything he did was to protect her. Some things, when he was willing to say them, he would naturally say.

Chen Ji placed the eighth page fragment into the Tianji Record, and all the fragments merged completely. After the glow faded, the Tianji Record returned to its ancient, simple appearance. But Chen Ji knew this book had completely awakened—its mission was about to be fulfilled.

The twenty-nine-day countdown began now. And in these twenty-nine days, Chen Ji still had many things to do—find his sister Chen Nian, deal with the counterattack from the Heavenly Eye, complete the final step of the path of reversing fate...
More importantly—he wanted to, within this limited time, leave enough contingencies for Su Qingyao, for Ye Qing, for everyone he cared about. So that even if he was gone, they could still live well.

Chen Ji raised his head, gazing into the depths of the Void. He knew the Heavenly Eye was watching him from there, and that gaze transcending all things might already carry a hint of wariness. But he did not care—he only cared whether he could, before the final moment arrived, pave the way for everyone.

"Let's go." Chen Ji said softly to Su Qingyao. "There are still many things to do." He turned to gaze at the distant horizon, a flash of determination crossing his eyes—the path of reversing fate had been opened. No turning back.
In twenty-nine days, regardless of the outcome, he would face the final resolution of fate. And before that, he wanted to make his death... meaningful.
When the truth of the first path was revealed, Chen Ji finally understood that the so-called freedom, its price was everything he was most unwilling to lose...
